title: Homeodomain protein Sxi1alpha independently controls cell-cell fusion and gene expression during sexual reproduction in Cryptococcus deneoformans.
authors: Huang, Jun; Lehmann, Anna E; Peterson, Patricia P; Xu, Ziyan; Xiong, Liping; Sun, Sheng; Heitman, Joseph
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌HD蛋白Sxi1alpha/Sxi2a在生殖中的转录调控与细胞融合功能，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（转录因子）但以湿实验和转录组为主，仅用AlphaFold3预测复合物，缺乏AI/物理模拟方法对TF-DNA结合机制的深入建模。
abstract: Sex-specific homeodomain (HD) proteins are key regulators of cell identity and sexual development in fungi, typically functioning as heterodimers to govern transcription. In the human fungal pathogens Cryptococcus neoformans and Cryptococcus deneoformans, the HD proteins Sxi1alpha and Sxi2a (Sex-inducer 1alpha and 2a) have been characterized as interacting components that play critical roles in sexual development during alpha x a sexual reproduction. alpha cells are the predominant mating type in natural populations of Cryptococcus, and unisexual (same-sex) mating can also occur in certain genetic backgrounds. The roles of Sxi1alpha and Sxi2a in unisexual reproduction are not fully understood. To elucidate the functions of Sxi1alpha and Sxi2a, we first applied AlphaFold3 prediction, which identified potential heterodimeric and homodimeric complexes. Formation of a Sxi2a homodimer was then experimentally validated through yeast two-hybrid assays. We subsequently deleted SXI1alpha and SXI2a in the hyper-filamentous self-fertile C. deneoformans strains XL280alpha and XL280a. Disruption of these genes did not result in noticeable defects in vegetative growth, virulence-associated traits, colony morphology, sporulation, or competitive fitness during unisexual crosses. Interestingly, both bilateral (mutant x mutant) and unilateral (mutant x wild type) crosses involving the sxi1alphaDelta mutant showed significantly increased alpha-alpha cell fusion efficiency, suggesting a previously unrecognized inhibitory role for Sxi1alpha in regulating same-sex cell fusion. Consistently, genes encoding mating pheromones and the alpha-pheromone receptor Ste3 were upregulated in the sxi1alphaDelta fusion assays. Transcriptomic analysis of sxi1alphaDelta and sxi2aDelta mutants led to the identification of unique subsets of genes negatively regulated by each transcription factor during unisexual reproduction. Additionally, alpha x a crosses between sxi1alphaDelta and sxi2aDelta mutants revealed differential regulation of mating-type (MAT) loci genes dependent only on Sxi1alpha or Sxi2a. Together, our findings reveal a novel role for Sxi1alpha in governing cell fusion and demonstrate that Sxi1alpha and Sxi2a have distinct transcriptional control during unisexual and alpha x a sexual reproduction, potentially exerting opposing regulation of sex-specific MAT genes.
abstract_zh: 性别特异性同源结构域（homeodomain, HD）蛋白是真菌中细胞身份和性别发育的关键调控因子，通常以异源二聚体形式发挥转录调控作用。在人类病原真菌新生隐球菌（Cryptococcus neoformans）和格特隐球菌（Cryptococcus deneoformans）中，HD蛋白Sxi1α和Sxi2a（性别诱导因子1α和2a）已被表征为相互作用组分，在α×a有性生殖过程中的性别发育中发挥关键作用。α细胞是隐球菌自然种群中的主要交配型，且在某些遗传背景下也可发生单性（同性）交配。Sxi1α和Sxi2a在单性生殖中的作用尚未完全阐明。为揭示Sxi1α和Sxi2a的功能，我们首先应用AlphaFold3预测，识别出潜在的异源二聚体和同源二聚体复合物。随后通过酵母双杂交实验验证了Sxi2a同源二聚体的形成。我们进一步在超丝状自育性C. deneoformans菌株XL280α和XL280a中敲除了SXI1α和SXI2a。这些基因的破坏未导致营养生长、毒力相关性状、菌落形态、孢子形成或单性杂交中竞争适应性的明显缺陷。有趣的是，涉及sxi1αΔ突变体的双侧（突变体×突变体）和单侧（突变体×野生型）杂交均显示α-α细胞融合效率显著提高，提示Sxi1α在调控同性细胞融合中具有此前未被识别的抑制作用。一致地，编码交配信息素和α-信息素受体Ste3的基因在sxi1αΔ融合实验中上调。对sxi1αΔ和sxi2aΔ突变体的转录组分析鉴定出每个转录因子在单性生殖中负调控的独特基因亚群。此外，sxi1αΔ和sxi2aΔ突变体之间的α×a杂交揭示了交配型（MAT）位点基因的差异调控，该调控仅依赖于Sxi1α或Sxi2a。综合来看，我们的发现揭示了Sxi1α在调控细胞融合中的新作用，并证明Sxi1α和Sxi2a在单性及α×a有性生殖中具有不同的转录控制，可能对性别特异性MAT基因施加相反的调控。
